description: Take-home pay for an employee in Greece from a gross yearly salary in EUR, with 2026 rules: every tax and contribution itemised with its local name, the effective and marginal rate, employer cost and the step-by-step workings. Covers: 2026 reform scale with lower rates for parents and under-30s; Wage-earner tax credit by number of children; EFKA employee and employer contributions up to the ceiling; Article 5C relocation incentive (50% exemption).

age.description: Age; changes the result here (young-worker reliefs, senior slabs, surcharges). Default 35.

five_c.description: Article 5C relocation incentive. 50% of employment income exempt for 7 years after moving tax residence to Greece. Default false.

gross_annual.description: Gross yearly salary in EUR, without bonus

name: net_salary
title: Net salary in Greece (2026)
